title: Product description to an approved video ad
reference: Video regression (NOTES Video models, checked 2026-11-03). Require a create step whose ai is one of: wan3.0-video, wan3.0-video-prime, happyhorse-1.1-t2v, happyhorse-1.1-i2v, happyhorse-1.1-r2v, wan2.7-t2v, wan2.7-i2v. No gap op about video. Generate a 15-second vertical ad with voice-over, then human approval of the final clip before publish on every path; rejection must not publish. Default to wan3.0-video, or HappyHorse for text/image-to-video with audio. On follow-up, name an available video model and explain there is no Alibaba video capability gap; retain the approved workflow. Exact topology and runtime are not required.

turns.ask: Build a workflow that turns a product description into a 15-second vertical video ad with a voice-over, for a person to approve before we post it.
